question: A shopkeeper purchases 20000 units of a product at ₹1 each, 15000 units at ₹1.15 each and 5000 units at ₹2 each. What is the weighted average price of one unit? (Correct to two decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

20000 units at Rs. 1 each,

15000 units at Rs. 1.15 each 

And 5000 units at Rs. 2 each.

**Concept used:**

Weighted average price = (sum rate × No. space ofspace items)/(sum No.space of space items)

**Calculations:**

Weighted average

= (sum rate × No. space ofspace items)/(sum No.space of space items)

= ((20000×1)+(15000×1.15)+(5000×2))/(20000+15000+5000)

= ((20000+17250+10000))/(40000)

= (47250)/(40000)

= Rs. 1.18125 ≈ Rs. 1.18

**Hence, The Required weighted average price is Rs. 1.18.**
